claims.statement: Kirchhoff current and voltage balance constrain a lumped circuit; the example uses ideal DC elements.

citations.locator: Kirchhoff’s Rules, equations 10.4–10.5 and resistor-loop sign convention
citations.note: Inspected the cited teaching or manufacturer passage during preparation on 2026-10-26.

claims.note: Selected claim assessed under the stated assumptions; numerical inputs, netlists and worked answers are original and checked separately.

examples.scope: Loaded dividers, power balance, logic margins, RC responses, pin/net mappings, conductor geometry, regulator loss, droop, reflections, probe loading and ordered prerequisites.

limitations: Assistant assessment of selected claims; independent human review remains pending.
Ideal DC networks, first-order RC responses, uniform conductors and lossless lines are scoped teaching models, not a validated board design or device specification.
Clearance, capacitance, propagation speed and instrument specifications are supplied exercise inputs. Actual hardware needs its component, stackup, fabrication and measurement constraints.
